answer_1.quote: We then evaluated each trained model in a few-shot in-context learning (ICL) setting on two logical reasoning tasks: Formal Logic Deduction (FLD) and bAbi, which do not require commonsense or world knowledge.

answer_2.quote: We measured the accuracy of the final answers for both FLD and FLD* ... The bAbI dataset ... we report accuracy and F1 scores on GLUE tasks.
